codex.model: read from ~/.codex/config.toml [model] (expected gpt-6.1-sol, needs codex-cli >= 0.159.1); never passed as -m
codex.note: effort is passed per-run as -c model_reasoning_effort=<effort> so the panel does not change the global config.toml default

gemini.rule: run `agy models`; highest Gemini version wins; pro beats flash on a tie; take the -high variant

grok.rule: run `~/.grok/bin/grok models`; highest grok version wins (ignore -build/-fast variants); effort always passed explicitly as --reasoning-effort <roster effort> because ~/.grok/config.toml has its own default

claude.note: model and effort live in ~/.claude/agents/<agent>.md frontmatter
